_note: One page per ad angle (PLAN.md section 6). leadShort is the hero line on a phone (under 600 px), shorter so the first question and its answers fit the first screen; lead stays everywhere else and in the share card. Each is its own static page at /<slug>, so Meta's crawler reads its own words. Only the hero changes; everything below it is shared, so a test compares one thing: the angle. To add one: a new entry, then node tools/build.mjs. hook is the ad's first line, kept here so the page and the ad are written together.
